skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain economic phenomena related to human resource economics at organizational, industry, and local levels.
Apply theories to evaluate and forecast changes in the labor market under different scenarios.
Develop listening skills and ability to negotiate and solve problems interactively.
Conduct independent research including analysis, synthesis, and generalization of socio-economic issues.
Identify and propose solutions for specific problems within the field of study.
Proactively improve self-study and research capabilities with innovative approaches.
Plan, coordinate, and complete tasks effectively, both individually and in teams.
Master skills in collecting information and analyzing human resource management activities in organizations.
Demonstrate critical thinking in evaluating and proposing solutions for specific problems.
